title: FPRAS for cell-bounded contingency tables
exact_target: For arbitrary binary nonnegative row and column margins and binary upper bounds on every cell, is there one randomized relative counting scheme using polynomial worst-case bit time in total input length, $\varepsilon ^{-1}$ and $\log (\delta ^{-1})$, with failure probability $\delta $ and certain zero output for emptiness, without a counting or sampling oracle?
